facts.fact: The Uganda Communications Commission ordered a temporary suspension of internet access nationwide (broadband and mobile) from 13 January 2026, ahead of the 15 January general election, with exemptions for critical infrastructure such as the UIXP; the record gives the end as 17 January 2026 20:00 UTC, a duration of 4 days 5 hours.
facts.system: National internet access (broadband and mobile), January 2026 election shutdown

note: The 1 January 2026 Starlink disablement is stated as following a UCC request, not an order, so no fact is taken; the 2021 shutdown is mentioned only as history without a date of its own.
